classification.resume: This is an audio recording of a parliamentary question session in the Swiss National Council on 23 September 2002, where National Councillor Alexander Baumann J. asked about the Federal Office of Civil Aviation's (OFAP) oversight of the BPV. Federal Councillor Ruth Metzler responded to the question.
